sn22.18:1.3: The cause and condition for the arising of form is also impermanent.
sn22.18:1.4: As form has originated from what is impermanent, how could it be permanent?
sn22.18:1.13: The cause and condition for the arising of consciousness is also impermanent.
sn22.18:1.14: As consciousness has originated from what is impermanent, how could it be permanent?
sn22.18:1.16: He understands: ‘… there is no more for this state of being.’”
